from pathlib import Path
source = '''import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv("table.csv")
regions = df["Region"].drop_duplicates().tolist()
sectors = ["Tourism", "Manufacturing", "Agriculture", "IT Services", "Oil & Gas"]
colors = sns.color_palette("Spectral", as_cmap=False, n_colors=9).as_hex()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(14, 10))
values = df.pivot(index="Region", columns="Sector", values="Export_Value").reindex(
    index=regions, columns=sectors
).fillna(0)
left = pd.Series(0.0, index=regions)

for sector, color in zip(sectors, colors):
    widths = values[sector]
    ax.barh(regions, widths, left=left, color=color, height=0.8, label=sector)
    for i, (width, start) in enumerate(zip(widths, left)):
        if width > 0:
            ax.text(start + width / 2, i, f"{width:g}",
                    ha="center", va="center", fontsize=9, color="black")
    left = left + widths

ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.set_title("Regional Export Values by Sector and GDP Contribution (2023)",
             fontsize=16, pad=20)
ax.set_xlabel("Export Value (Billion USD)", fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel("Region", fontsize=12)
ax.set_xticks([])
ax.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=10)
ax.set_xlim(0, left.max() * 1.05)
ax.legend(title="Sector", loc="center left", bbox_to_anchor=(1.01, 0.5),
          frameon=False)
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig("output.png", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
'''
Path("chart.py").write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, "chart.py", "exec"))
print("Limits:", ax.get_xlim())
print("Title:", ax.get_title())
print("Legend:", ax.get_legend_handles_labels()[1])
print("Region totals:", left.to_dict())
print("Labels:", [t.get_text() for t in ax.texts])
